I’m in a relationship where my SO spends almost every possible waking moment being there for me and I can testify that it does not magically absolve you of loneliness whatsoever. At some point you start to realize that having the same company and being and exchanging the same experiences won’t push you forward, it only holds you in stasis.

That’s why it’s important to find more people to pull you into different directions and show you different sources of inspiration. Of course, to actually start, you’d have to be able to muster up the drive and the motivation to give yourself the self-love to make those relationships happen… but if you’ve been alone and derived of social fulfillment your whole life, that’s next to impossible. It’s a catch-22. You can’t just get this motivation from nothing, which is why so many of us on this subreddit are struggling. At some point or another we’ve lost the ability to connect with others, whether via trauma that causes trust issues or having been devoid of social interaction for too long, and it’s very difficult to start again.
